Because A Little Help
Goes a Long Way.

At Luxe Signature & Co., we believe kindness belongs in the details. We recognize that some seasons of life call for a little extra support, and we’re happy to offer special savings to those who deserve it.

Expecting & New Moms

◆

Between preparing for a new arrival, caring for little ones, and keeping up with everyday life, moms have plenty on their plates. Let us take a little of the household work off your hands.

Enjoy special pricing for expecting mothers and new moms.

Veteran Appreciation

◆

A sincere thank-you to those who have served our country. Enjoy special savings on qualifying Luxe services as our way of showing appreciation.

Personalized & Prorated Options

◆

Every home, budget, and situation is different. We understand that sometimes a little flexibility can make all the difference. If you’re interested in a prorated discount or need something that better fits your circumstances, please don’t hesitate to reach out. Call, text, or email us today! We’d be happy to discuss your needs and explore available options.

Moms, single parents, and veterans always receive our standard 5–10% discount, and we offer prorated rates for those who need a little extra help.
